title: Japanese-Style Scallops Noodle Stir Fry
description: Quick and flavorful, this dish brings together the delicate flavors of Japan with the succulent taste of scallops. Perfect for a weeknight dinner!
instructions: Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add scallops and cook until browned and cooked through, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Remove scallops from skillet and set aside.
Add noodles to skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until slightly tender.
Add soy sauce, sesame oil, and rice vinegar to skillet and stir to combine.
Return scallops to skillet and stir to coat with sauce.
Transfer noodles and scallops to a serving platter and top with green onions and sesame seeds.
